scope: Single-eye source geometry acceptance for conditional isolated dual-eye/Focus/6clip expansion, not final asset or commercial art acceptance
limitations: Read-only geometry audit of the saved single-eye .blend, including a 101-state native piecewise-linear Blink sweep. No renderer, GLB export, Godot, game runtime, Focus combinations, or six-clip acceptance.
Armature modifiers are disabled in the background process to isolate intrinsic shape geometry and corner normals; shape source coordinates are compared directly.
Negative +Y normals and projected crossings identify radial orientation issues; original source annulus can have its own non-planar geometry.
Relative sliver threshold is 1e-4 times the state radial triangle median area; absolute degeneracy threshold is 1e-12 square metres.

3D intersection checks cover this Face mesh only, exclude triangles sharing a vertex, and count strict transverse penetrations or coplanar interior overlap at 1e-8 m tolerance. They do not cover inter-object contacts with Body, Globe, or oral assets, and exclude boundary-only touching.
relative_radial_normals_over90_degrees: Maximum41 during closure retained in raw review; positiveY and strict crossings checked separately
